name: CyberSphere
author: theNfan
description:
CyberSphere was created as Prototype 4 with bonus features and a lot more for the Junior Programmer Pathway.

- Controls: Gamepad (recommended) or Cursor Keys/WASD and CTRL. P or Pause to pause the game
- Three levels of enemies
- Bosses...who fight back
- Bounce attack, smash attack and target seeking missiles
- Physics
- Lightning
- Texturing
- Particle effects
- Sound effects
- Background music
